messages.content: 計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。

function.name: statistics_calculate_p_value
function.description: Calculate the p-value for a t-test on a single sample from a population. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

sample_mean.description: The mean of the sample data. This is a float type value.

population_mean.description: The mean of the population data. This is a float type value.

sample_std_dev.description: The standard deviation of the sample data. This is a float type value.

sample_size.description: The size of the sample data.

two_tailed.description: Whether the test is two-tailed. If not provided, default is true.

message.reasoning: The user says: "計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。" They want to calculate something about hypothesis testing? They mention sample mean 98.2, sample std dev 1.4, sample size 40, null hypothesis mean 98.6. They ask: "計算...的標準差" maybe they want the standard error? Or they want the p-value? The phrase "零假設檢定的標準差" might be "standard deviation for the null hypothesis test"? Actually "零假設檢定的標準差" could be "standard deviation of the test statistic under the null hypothesis". That would be the standard error of the mean: sigma/sqrt(n). But we don't know population sigma; we have sample sigma 1.4. So standard error = 1.4 / sqrt(40) ≈ 1.4 / 6.3249 ≈ 0.2215. But if they want the t-statistic: (98.2 - 98.6) / (1.4 / sqrt(40)) = (-0.4) / 0.2215 ≈ -1.805. Then p-value two-tailed: 2 * P(T > |t|) with df=39. Let's compute approximate p-value. For t=1.805, df=39. Using t distribution table: t=1.685 gives p=0.10, t=1.685? Actually for df=40, t=1.684 gives p=0.10. t=1.860 gives p=0.07. So p ~ 0.07. So p-value ~ 0.07. But the question: "計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。" Might be asking to compute the standard deviation of the sampling distribution of the mean under null hypothesis? That is the standard error: 1.4 / sqrt(40) = 0.2215. But they might want the p-value. The phrase "零假設檢定的標準差" is ambiguous. They might want to compute the standard deviation of the test statistic? That is the standard error. So answer: 0.2215. But we can also provide t-statistic and p-value. The user didn't specify significance level. So we can compute p-value. Let's use the function to compute p-value. We'll call the function with sample_mean=98.2, population_mean=98.6, sample_std_dev=1.4, sample_size=40. Use two_tailed default true.
